evidence.statement: The paymentmethods table maps CardHolderName (max 200), Alias, CardNumber (required, max 25), Expiration and CardTypeId from private fields. The orders table maps OrderStatus as a string (max 30), owns the Address value object (street, city, state, zip, country) and links PaymentMethodId and BuyerId. Creating an order raises OrderStartedDomainEvent, whose in-process handler creates or finds the Buyer and adds a PaymentMethod built from the command's card fields including the security number.

evidence.statement: GetSubscriptionsOfType returns every subscription of the event type (db.Subscriptions.Where(s => s.Type == type)) with no UserId or order-owner predicate. The Paid and Shipped handlers pass that full list with a WebhookData built by serializing the received event to JSON to WebhooksSender.SendAll. Webhooks.API's own event records carry OrderId and OrderStockItems (ProductId, Units) for Paid, and OrderId, OrderStatus and BuyerName for Shipped. Ordering.API's published Paid event also carries BuyerIdentityGuid, which Webhooks.API's record does not declare. Delivery is therefore to all subscribers of a type, for any user's order.
evidence.limitations: WebhookData.cs seen through search context (lines 1-16); WebhooksSender internals were read at collection (E11). The per-subscription Token header handling on delivery was not re-read.

evidence.statement: LoggingBehavior logs every command with the {@Command} destructuring operator before and after the handler, and the response. ValidatorBehavior logs the command and the validation failures when validation fails. TransactionBehavior opens a database transaction, logs the command at begin and on error, commits, and only then publishes integration events (PublishEventsThroughEventBusAsync(transactionId)) inside the execution strategy. CreateOrderCommand exposes CardNumber, CardHolderName, CardExpiration and CardSecurityNumber as [DataMember] properties with no log-exclusion attribute seen. Validators: Create checks required address fields, card number length 12-19, security number length 3, future expiry and at least one item; Cancel and Ship check only that OrderNumber is non-empty. RequestManager.CreateRequestForCommandAsync saves a ClientRequest (Id, Name = command type name, Time) and throws if the id already exists; the record carries no user or payload binding.
evidence.limitations: Behavior registration order and whether RequestManager's SaveChanges falls inside TransactionBehavior's transaction were not read (G8). How {@Command} is rendered depends on the logging provider, which was not observed (G-s01-log-sinks). IdentifiedCommandValidator was not read.

evidence.statement: Order is created with OrderStatus.Submitted (constructor, line 57). SetAwaitingValidationStatus acts only from Submitted; SetStockConfirmedStatus only from AwaitingValidation; SetPaidStatus only from StockConfirmed; each is a silent no-op from any other state. SetShippedStatus throws unless the status is Paid. SetCancelledStatus throws only from Paid or Shipped, so it succeeds from Submitted, AwaitingValidation, StockConfirmed and also from Cancelled (raising OrderCancelledDomainEvent again). SetCancelledStatusWhenStockIsRejected acts only from AwaitingValidation. The Paid description reads as a simulated bank account. Order state changes raise domain events that become integration events.
evidence.limitations: Domain model read in full; the callers (command handlers and integration event handlers) are covered by E7, E9, E12 and unread handler bodies (G-s01-event-handlers).

flows.description: Operation: Browse the storefront and start sign-in. Initiator context: unauthenticated client. Receiver and trust decision: WebApp serves pages; page-level authorization unread (UN-005); a protected page challenges through OIDC. Authority carried: none.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Use basket, checkout and order pages over a Blazor circuit. Initiator context: signed-in customer. Receiver and trust decision: WebApp validates its authentication cookie. Authority carried: customer identity via cookie; WebApp later attaches the customer's access token downstream.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Send a chat message. Initiator context: signed-in customer. Receiver and trust decision: WebApp passes the text to the chat client when a model is configured. Authority carried: customer text; no authority beyond the circuit.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Sign in with username and password on the Identity.API login page. Initiator context: customer browser. Receiver and trust decision: Identity.API authenticates against the ASP.NET Identity store; antiforgery and local-return-URL checks seen by grep. Authority carried: password credential; yields the Identity session cookie and, after the code flow, tokens.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Sign in as a seeded account. Initiator context: anyone knowing the sample credential. Receiver and trust decision: Identity.API treats it as an ordinary user. Authority carried: full customer authority for alice or bob where the seed ran.
flows.rationale: Seeded accounts exist at every startup in the code read; deployment use is not observed.

flows.description: Operation: Implicit-flow token request from Swagger UI pages. Initiator context: developer or any holder of a registered redirect. Receiver and trust decision: Identity.API issues access tokens to the browser (AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser). Authority carried: scopes of the basket, ordering or webhooks API for the signed-in user.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: OIDC authorization-code exchange as client 'webapp'. Initiator context: customer sign-in. Receiver and trust decision: Identity.API checks the client secret (shared sample value) and the user; RequirePkce is false for this client. Authority carried: client 'webapp' registration; scopes orders, basket, webhooks plus webshoppingagg (not in the API scope list); offline access.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Token response with id, access and refresh tokens. Initiator context: customer sign-in. Receiver and trust decision: WebApp stores the tokens in its session (SaveTokens = true). Authority carried: tokens signed with the developer signing credential; user subject.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Call /api/catalog, /api/orders or /identity through the gateway. Initiator context: unauthenticated client. Receiver and trust decision: YARP routes; no gateway authentication policy or per-route method restriction in the configuration read. Authority carried: none at the gateway.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Mobile catalog and order calls and sign-in through /identity. Initiator context: customer on a mobile device. Receiver and trust decision: same gateway as above. Authority carried: customer bearer token on orders; public client 'maui' registration with PKCE, plus an embedded secret constant.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Forward /api/catalog/{*any} (any method per E3). Initiator context: anonymous or signed-in caller. Receiver and trust decision: Catalog registers no authentication, so no identity decision is made. Authority carried: none required; any token present is not evaluated.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Forward /api/orders/{*any} (api-version 1.0|1). Initiator context: signed-in customer. Receiver and trust decision: Ordering validates the JWT (issuer, signature, lifetime; audience off) and requires only an authenticated caller. Authority carried: the caller's bearer token if the route forwards it; header forwarding not observed in the route configuration.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Forward /identity/{*any}. Initiator context: mobile sign-in. Receiver and trust decision: Identity.API endpoints as in EP-identity-ui. Authority carried: user credentials and client credentials of the caller.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: gRPC GetBasket, UpdateBasket, DeleteBasket (also chatbot AddToCart and GetCartContents). Initiator context: signed-in customer or the chat model acting in that circuit. Receiver and trust decision: Basket validates the JWT; GetBasket is anonymous and returns an empty basket without a subject; Update and Delete need sub. Authority carried: the user's access token forwarded by AddAuthToken; the basket key comes only from the token subject.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: HTTP read calls (version 2) for catalog browsing and tool searches. Initiator context: customer or chat tool. Receiver and trust decision: Catalog makes no identity decision. Authority carried: the user's token is attached but not evaluated.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Forward /product-images/{id} to the catalog picture endpoint. Initiator context: any caller of the WebApp route. Receiver and trust decision: Catalog resolves the file by the stored PictureFileName. Authority carried: none.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: List, get, create and cancel orders. Initiator context: signed-in customer. Receiver and trust decision: Ordering requires an authenticated caller only; by-id read, cancel and ship use no owner filter; create takes UserId from the body. Authority carried: the user's access token forwarded by AddAuthToken; ownership rests on body fields rather than the token on create.
flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Chat completion with function calling. Initiator context: customer text, catalog descriptions and tool results. flows.description: Operation: Model-issued function calls: GetUserInfo, SearchCatalog, AddToCart, GetCartContents. Initiator context: model output shaped by user text and catalog descriptions. flows.rationale: Directed hop as read in source; deployed behavior unobserved.

flows.description: Operation: Publish order status and order-started events after the transaction commits. Initiator context: a committed order command. flows.description: Operation: Publish ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent when an item price changes (other publications unread). Initiator context: unauthenticated PUT on items. flows.description: Operation: Publish GracePeriodConfirmed after the grace period. Initiator context: 30 second poll of orders. Receiver and trust decision: the broker accepts any holder of the shared credential. Authority carried: broker credential; no sender identity.

flows.description: Operation: Publish OrderPaymentSucceeded or OrderPaymentFailed. Initiator context: StockConfirmed event. states.description: Submitted: set by the Order constructor. A client create call with a new x-requestid reaches it; the card, address and buyer rows are created by an in-process handler. Cancel is allowed here.
states.rationale: Entry state of the order lifecycle.

states.description: Grace window: a time condition on Submitted orders. OrderProcessor polls every 30 seconds with a 1 minute grace period and publishes GracePeriodConfirmed. Cancel through the API is not blocked during this window. The selection query body was not read.
states.rationale: Pending outcome awaiting a timer, not a stored status.

states.description: AwaitingValidation: Submitted moves here through SetAwaitingValidationStatus, expected on GracePeriodConfirmed; Ordering's handler was not read. Stock rejection moves it to Cancelled.
StockConfirmed: reached only from AwaitingValidation. The trigger event comes from Catalog; the handler was not read.
Paid: reached only from StockConfirmed when a payment result event arrives. Payment is simulated from PaymentOptions.PaymentSucceeded.
Shipped: SetShippedStatus throws unless Paid. PUT ship is available to any authenticated caller with an OrderNumber; a comment says an administrator ships.
states.rationale: Terminal state; Shipped orders cannot be cancelled.

states.description: Cancelled: allowed from Submitted, AwaitingValidation, StockConfirmed and Cancelled; rejected from Paid and Shipped. Stock rejection also cancels from AwaitingValidation. Compensation for any held stock or payment on cancel is not shown in the code read.
states.rationale: Terminal state; a repeat cancel raises the cancelled domain event again.

states.description: Simulated payment: Succeeded or Failed chosen only by configuration; no gateway, no pending or unknown state exists. Failure event handling in Ordering was not read.
states.rationale: Transaction outcome of the payment step.

states.description: Request id consumed: x-requestid is recorded before the inner command runs. A repeat returns a canned success; a failed first attempt also consumes the id. The record does not bind user or payload, and whether the save falls inside the command transaction was not read.
states.rationale: Outcome of a client retry after a lost reply or a failure is the same response regardless of the first result.

dependencies.description: Order stays Submitted and enters the grace window until the timer fires; the client may cancel during it.

dependencies.description: Transition permitted only from AwaitingValidation when stock is confirmed. Requested by the stock confirmation event; replay from another state is silently ignored.

dependencies.description: Stock rejection cancels the order only from AwaitingValidation.

dependencies.description: Transition permitted only from StockConfirmed when a payment succeeded event arrives; the result comes from the simulated payment step. The event is correlated by the order id in its payload.

dependencies.description: Transition permitted only from Paid; requested through PUT ship by any authenticated caller. A second ship call throws.
